college: EASA College of Engineering and Technology

documents.title: EASA College Profile, History & Accreditation
documents.content: EASA College of Engineering and Technology (Autonomous) was established in 2008 by the EASA Foundation under the visionary leadership of Chairman T.D. Eswaramoorthy. Located on Palakkad Main Road, Navakkarai, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (PIN: 641105), the institution is approved by AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education), affiliated with Anna University Chennai, and accredited with an 'A' Grade by NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council). In 2024, EASA College attained Autonomous status from the UGC and Anna University, granting academic flexibility to update curriculum to cutting-edge industry demands. Vision: To be a premier institution recognized for academic excellence, innovative research, and transformative engineering leadership. Mission: To deliver high-quality technical education, nurture entrepreneurial skills, and foster ethical leadership for socio-economic progress. Contact phone numbers: +91 422 2363644 / 2363645, Admission hotline: +91 97888 88888, Email: info@easacollege.com, Website: https://www.easacollege.com.

documents.title: Undergraduate (UG) Admission 2026-27 & Eligibility
documents.content: ADMISSION OPEN FOR ACADEMIC YEAR 2026-27 at EASA College of Engineering and Technology. EASA College offers 10 Bachelor's degree programmes across engineering and emerging technologies. General B.E / B.Tech Eligibility: Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary Examination (HSC 10+2) or equivalent with Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry as compulsory subjects with minimum qualifying marks as prescribed by the Government of Tamil Nadu and Anna University guidelines (Open Category: 45%, BC/BCM/MBC/DNC: 40%, SC/SCA/ST: 40%). Lateral Entry Admission: Diploma holders in Engineering/Technology or B.Sc graduates with Mathematics at 10+2 level are eligible for direct 2nd-year (3rd semester) admission with minimum aggregate marks. Admission Modes: 1. Government Quota via Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA) Single Window Counselling (TNEA Counselling Code: 2755). 2. Management Quota through direct institutional application. For 2026-27 admission inquiries, contact Admission Cell at +91 97888 88888 or +91 422 2363644, or visit Admission Office at Navakkarai campus.

documents.title: Approved Undergraduate (UG) Degree Programmes
documents.content: EASA College of Engineering and Technology offers 10 specialized Undergraduate (UG) programmes for 4 years duration (8 semesters): 1. B.E. Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) - Focus: Algorithms, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Full-Stack Development. 2. B.E. CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) - Focus: Neural Networks, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Generative AI. 3. B.E. CSE (Cyber Security) - Focus: Cryptography, Network Security, Ethical Hacking, Cyber Forensics. 4. B.E. Biomedical Engineering (BME) - Focus: Medical Electronics, Biomechanics, Diagnostic Equipment, Healthcare Automation. 5. B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) - Focus: Embedded Systems, VLSI, IoT, Wireless Communications, Signal Processing. 6. B.E. Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) - Focus: Power Systems, Renewable Energy, Electric Vehicles, Control Automation. 7. B.E. Mechanical Engineering - Focus: CAD/CAM/CAE, Robotics, Thermal Engineering, Industrial Automation. 8. B.Tech. Information Technology (IT) - Focus: Web & Mobile Technologies, Data Engineering, Information Security. 9. B.Tech. Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI & DS) - Focus: Big Data Analytics, Predictive Modeling, NLP, Data Visualization. 10. B.Tech. Agricultural Engineering - Focus: Farm Machinery, Irrigation Systems, Food Processing, Soil Mechanics. All programmes follow modern autonomous curricula aligned with industry standards.

documents.title: Postgraduate (PG) & Management Degree Programmes
documents.content: EASA College offers Master's degree programmes across engineering disciplines and business administration: 1. M.E. Computer Science and Engineering (2 Years) - Focus on Advanced Algorithms, Distributed Systems, High Performance Computing. 2. M.E. Structural Engineering (2 Years) - Focus on Earthquake Resistant Structures, Finite Element Analysis, Concrete Technology. 3. M.E. Construction Engineering and Management (2 Years) - Focus on Project Management, Construction Safety, Cost Estimation. 4. M.E. Manufacturing Engineering (2 Years) - Focus on Advanced Manufacturing, CNC, Additive Manufacturing. 5. M.E. Communication Systems (2 Years) - Focus on 5G/6G Networks, RF Design, Optical Communication. 6. M.E. Power Electronics and Drives (2 Years) - Focus on Power Converters, EV Drives, Smart Grids. 7. MBA - Master of Business Administration (2 Years) with specializations in Human Resource Management (HR), Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Systems. Eligibility for M.E: Relevant B.E/B.Tech degree with minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) and TANCET / GATE score. Eligibility for MBA: Any Bachelor's degree of 3+ years with minimum 50% (45% for reserved categories) and TANCET / MAT / CET score.

documents.title: Scholarships, Tuition Waivers & Financial Assistance
documents.content: EASA College provides extensive merit and need-based financial aid for eligible students: 1. Merit Scholarships: Full and partial tuition fee waivers awarded to high-ranking students in 10+2 board examinations and top TNEA single-window cutoffs. 2. Sports Scholarships: Fee concessions for national, state, and divisional level sports achievers in athletics, football, basketball, badminton, and cricket. 3. First Graduate Tuition Waiver: Government of Tamil Nadu First Graduate tuition concession of Rs. 25,000/- per year applicable for eligible candidates admitted via government single-window quota. 4. Post-Matric Scholarships: Full tuition and exam fee coverage for SC/SCA/ST/converted Christian students as per Government rules. 5. EASA Trust Merit Assistance: Special concessions for economically disadvantaged and rural students. Inquire at Admission Cell for current scholarship verification.

documents.title: Hostel Facilities, Accommodation & Mess Services
documents.content: EASA College of Engineering and Technology provides separate, secure, and well-equipped hostels for boys and girls on campus: 1. Boys' Hostel: Capacity of 250+ students with 60+ ventilated rooms in a multi-storey (G+3) block. 2. Girls' Hostel: Independent secure residential block with dedicated female security guards and CCTV surveillance. Facilities: High-speed Wi-Fi internet connectivity, 24/7 uninterrupted power backup, RO purified drinking water stations on each floor, reading and recreation rooms with indoor games (table tennis, chess, carrom), gym access, laundry support, and 24/7 medical on-call assistance with emergency vehicle. Mess: Spacious hygienic dining halls serving balanced, nutritious South Indian and North Indian vegetarian and non-vegetarian food prepared by experienced cooks. Warden & Safety: Full-time resident wardens oversee discipline, safety, and student welfare. Strict anti-ragging policies enforced. Note: For current 2026-27 hostel room rental and mess charges, students must consult the hostel warden or admission office directly.

documents.title: College Transport & Comprehensive Bus Routes
documents.content: EASA College maintains a modern fleet of comfortable college buses operating across Coimbatore district, surrounding towns, and nearby Kerala border regions to ensure safe and punctual daily commute: Key Routes in Tamil Nadu: 1. Gandhipuram Route: Gandhipuram Central Bus Stand - Cross-Cut Road - Lakshmi Mills - Ramanathapuram - Sundarapuram - Kinathukadavu - Navakkarai Campus. 2. Singanallur Route: Singanallur - Ondipudur - Trichy Road - Eachanari - Campus. 3. Ukkadam Route: Ukkadam Bus Stand - Athupalam - Kuniamuthur - Kovaipudur Pirivu - Campus. 4. Pollachi Route: Pollachi Bus Stand - Achipatti - Kinathukadavu - Othakalmandapam - Campus. 5. Anaimalai Route: Anaimalai - Vettaikaranpudur - Pollachi - Campus. 6. Thondamuthur & Vadavalli Route: Vadavalli - Thondamuthur - Perur - Campus. Kerala Border Routes: Dedicated buses operate from Palakkad, Chittur, Kozhinjampara, Walayar, and Kanjikode. Safety: All buses are equipped with GPS tracking and speed governors, driven by experienced institutional drivers.

documents.title: Training & Placement Cell Support and Recruiters
documents.content: The Centre for Corporate Relations and Placement at EASA College provides rigorous 360-degree training starting from the 1st year to ensure high employability: Training Modules: 1. Quantitative Aptitude & Logical Reasoning. 2. Technical Coding (C, Python, Java, Data Structures, Full-Stack, AI frameworks). 3. Communication and Soft Skills development. 4. Mock Technical and HR Interviews conducted by industry professionals. 5. Company-specific preparatory bootcamps. Top Recruiting Partners: Companies visiting for on-campus and pooled drives include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Zoho, HCL, Tech Mahindra, Hexaware, L&T Technology Services, Capgemini, Bosch, and regional core engineering enterprises. Career Guidance Cell also assists students aspiring for Higher Education (GATE, GRE, CAT) and Public Sector / Defence competitive examinations.

documents.title: Academic Departments, Laboratories & Teaching Staff
documents.content: EASA College of Engineering and Technology features dedicated academic departments with state-of-the-art laboratories and qualified faculty: 1. Computer Science & Engineering (CSE / AI-ML / Cyber Security): Advanced Computing Labs, NVIDIA GPU AI Lab, Cloud Computing & IoT Lab, Cyber Security Sandbox. 2. Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE): VLSI Design Lab, DSP Lab, Microwave & Optical Lab, Embedded Microcontroller Lab. 3. Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE): Power Electronics Lab, Electrical Machines Lab, Control Systems Lab, Renewable Energy & EV Testing Rig. 4. Biomedical Engineering (BME): Biomedical Instrumentation Lab, Diagnostic and Therapeutic Equipment Lab, Pathology & Microbiology Lab. 5. Mechanical Engineering: CAD/CAM/CNC Simulation Lab, Thermal & Fluid Mechanics Lab, Manufacturing Technology Workshop, Strength of Materials Lab. 6. Information Technology & AI/Data Science: Big Data Analytics Lab, High-Performance Computing Cluster, Software Testing Lab. 7. Agricultural Engineering: Farm Machinery Yard, Soil & Water Conservation Lab, Irrigation Engineering Lab. 8. Management Studies (MBA): Digital Business & Analytics Lab, Executive Seminar Hall, Case Discussion Chamber. Faculty: Highly qualified Professors, Associate Professors, and Assistant Professors with M.E, M.Tech, MBA, and Ph.D qualifications.

documents.title: Campus Facilities: Library, Sports, Medical & Infrastructure
documents.content: EASA College campus is situated on a lush, serene 25+ acre eco-friendly site at Navakkarai, Coimbatore: 1. Central Library: 30,000+ volumes of technical books, reference books, National and International journals, IEEE electronic database access, and DELNET digital membership. 2. Computing Facilities: 500+ modern workstations networked with 1 Gbps high-speed dedicated leased line internet and Wi-Fi across campus. 3. Smart Classrooms: Ergonomically designed lecture halls with multimedia projectors and interactive digital smart boards. 4. Canteen & Cafeteria: Multi-cuisine hygienic canteen providing snacks, hot beverages, and meal options for day scholars and staff. 5. 24/7 ATM Facility: On-campus ATM for convenient banking. 6. Sports & Fitness: 400m athletic track, football ground, basketball court, volleyball court, cricket nets, indoor badminton court, and modern fitness gym. 7. Medical Centre: Dedicated campus healthcare clinic with resident nurse, regular doctor visits, and emergency ambulance on call.

documents.title: Student Support, Examination Cell & Grievance Redressal
documents.content: Student governance and administrative cells at EASA College: 1. Examination Cell (Autonomous): Headed by Controller of Examinations (COE), overseeing continuous internal assessments (CIA), autonomous end-semester examination timetables, grade cards, revaluation, and degree certificates as per Anna University / Autonomous regulations. 2. Grievance Redressal Committee: Transparent mechanism for addressing student and faculty academic or general grievances with online complaint submission. 3. Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) & Anti-Ragging Committee: Enforces zero-tolerance policy towards ragging in compliance with Supreme Court of India and AICTE guidelines. Anti-Ragging Helpline active 24/7. 4. Co-Curricular Clubs: National Service Scheme (NSS), Youth Red Cross (YRC), Rotaract Club, Coding Club, Robotics Club, Cultural & Fine Arts Club, and Women Empowerment Cell.

documents.title: Official Announcement: 2026-27 Engineering Admission Open
documents.content: OFFICIAL ADMISSION CIRCULAR 2026-27: Applications are officially invited for admission to B.E, B.Tech, M.E, and MBA programmes at EASA College of Engineering and Technology (Autonomous), Coimbatore for the 2026-27 academic session. faq.question: What courses are available at EASA College?
faq.answer: EASA College offers 10 B.E/B.Tech UG programmes (CSE, CSE-AI&ML, Cyber Security, Biomedical, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, IT, AI&DS, Agricultural) and 7 PG programmes (M.E in CSE, Structural, Construction, Manufacturing, Communication Systems, Power Electronics, and MBA).

faq.question: What is the eligibility for B.E admission at EASA?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 (HSC) with Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry with minimum aggregate marks prescribed by the Government of Tamil Nadu (45% for General Category, 40% for BC/MBC/SC/ST).

faq.question: What is the TNEA counselling code for EASA College?
faq.answer: The official TNEA single-window counselling code for EASA College of Engineering and Technology is 2755.

faq.question: Does EASA College have separate hostels for boys and girls?
faq.answer: Yes. EASA College provides separate, fully equipped hostels for boys (250+ capacity, 60+ rooms) and girls with 24/7 security, Wi-Fi, power backup, and hygienic dining mess.

faq.question: Does EASA College bus go to Gandhipuram?
faq.answer: Yes. Gandhipuram is one of the primary transport routes operated by EASA College buses, alongside Singanallur, Ukkadam, Pollachi, Anaimalai, and Kerala border routes.

faq.question: How can I contact the EASA admission office?
faq.answer: You can reach the EASA Admission Cell via phone at +91 97888 88888 or +91 422 2363644, or by email at info@easacollege.com, or visit the campus at Palakkad Main Road, Navakkarai, Coimbatore.
